issue_request: FHIR-51500 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request to review the Device-type search parameter and remove the expensive Device.definition.resolve().classification.type expression from that parameter.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied in commit d304eb5317, and git history confirms d304eb5317bd3162289cd96cac52484f37014390 changed source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml so Device-type uses expression Device.type.
additional_context: FHIR-40397 earlier added Device.definition-derived classification search behavior to Device code/type; the current source still has a separate Device-definition-code/code parameter with the resolve() expression. reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active Device-type search parameter source is already correct and no additional source edit is needed for FHIR-51500.
